يختلسون (form VIII)
# يَخْتَلِسُونَ (yaḵtalisūna) /jax.ta.li.suː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِخْتَلَسَ (iḵtalasa)
# يُخْتَلَسُونَ (yuḵtalasūna) /jux.ta.la.suː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِخْتَلَسَ (iḵtalasa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
